points.description: States the final number of infected people after three days as 3430, with valid working. Each day every currently infected person infects six new people, so the total is multiplied by 7 daily (10 → 70 → 490 → 3430), or equivalently 10 × 7³. Equivalent working and presentation earn the mark. Any invalid step or a wrong final answer earns no mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark requires the correct final answer of 3430 reached through mathematically valid steps. Because the model answer makes a single wrong step or wrong final answer cost the whole mark, there is no partial credit. The model answer text was not supplied, so the scheme assumes the standard reading that each infected person infects six new people each day.
